meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扩展 NanoClaw,接入新渠道、调整触发与路由。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想按需扩展 NanoClaw 的功能和连接。
copy.tagline_en: Extend NanoClaw with new channels, triggers, and integrations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to customize NanoClaw's behavior and add new capabilities.

howto.what: Claude 会先提问弄清你想改什么,再动手改 NanoClaw:增加输入渠道、接入 MCP 集成、调整触发规则与路由、改人格或部署方式,并告诉你怎么重构建和验证。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 加新输入渠道(Telegram、Slack、邮件等)、改触发词、加集成或改路由时,它会接管。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加 Telegram 作为输入渠道
say.note: 先装适配器,再问接到哪个 agent 组

say.text: 把这个 agent 组的人格改得更简短
给日历加一个 MCP 工具

howto.what_en: Claude first asks questions to learn what you want, then edits NanoClaw: adds input channels, MCP integrations, changes triggers and routing, or edits persona and deployment, and tells you how to rebuild and verify.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to add a channel (Telegram, Slack, email, etc.), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make other NanoClaw customizations.

say_en.text: Add Telegram as an input channel for NanoClaw
say_en.note: Installs the adapter, then asks which agent group

say_en.text: Make this agent group's persona more concise

say_en.note: Runs /add-gcal-tool or writes the container config
